neighbours.label: Names of the Gulf ruling families and their cities (' bin' in 'Mohammed bin Rashid', 'Al Maktoum', 'Al Nahyan', Dubai, Abu Dhabi), firing on ' bin' or the place name; other rulers and cities stay lower.
fire: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed is the crown prince.
The Al Maktoum family rules Dubai.
Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan founded the federation.
Abu Dhabi is ruled by the Al Nahyan family.
Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid opened the new tower.
The emir of Dubai attended the race.
Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed was president for years.
quiet: King Charles is the head of state.
The Windsor family lives in London.
Paris is run by an elected mayor.
The mayor opened the new tower.
The prince of Monaco attended the race.
Angela Merkel was chancellor for years.

short: Gulf royal names (bin Rashid, Al Maktoum, Dubai)
notes: Card: ' of' x2, Arabic ' سعود' x2, ' Dubai' x2, ' large' x2, ' called' x2, ' bin' (Sheikh Mohammed⟦ bin⟧ Rashid Al Maktoum), ' lateral' (rectus). Exploratory probe: 'Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid' 0.52, 'the ruler of Dubai' 0.42; but 'Osama bin Laden' 0.03.
